description: navigator.hardwareConcurrency. Conditioned on the resolved chip because on Apple silicon the chip fixes the core count: an Apple M1 has 8 cores and an Apple M4 Max has 14 or 16, so an unconditioned bucket list produces impossible machines. The Windows sets are weighted per GPU family from a public corpus of real Windows Chrome sessions, because the GPU a machine ships with does shift the likely CPU; the Linux sets remain authored. Selection is clamped down to the host's real core count and never up.
label: cpu
